actions.jobInProgress: A provisioning job is running; actions are paused

wizard.title: Hire Employee
wizard.slugHint: Unique handle used for account and workspace naming.
wizard.managerHint: Optional — you can change this later.
wizard.runtimeHint: Pick the runtime type that powers this employee.
wizard.providerHint: Bind an independent model to this employee. Reuse a company provider, create a private provider, or configure it later.
wizard.noCompanyProvider: No company provider is configured yet. Create a private setup or add one from the employee profile later.
wizard.apiKeyHint: The key is submitted once and encrypted by the server; plaintext is never displayed again.
wizard.providerLaterHint: Identity, workspace and runtime will still be provisioned. Bind a provider and model from the employee profile later.
wizard.learningHint: Let the employee retain retrospectives and delivery lessons as durable knowledge.

behaviorPreview.title: Effective behaviour preview
behaviorPreview.note: Computed by the server from the current company policy. Personality changes how the employee works, never the acceptance criteria.
behaviorPreview.noteLearningOff: Learning is off: quotas stay at the default working style.

wizard.packagesHint: Choose the access packages to grant; role defaults are pre-selected.
wizard.previewHint: These resources will be provisioned. Unavailable ones do not block hiring and can be retried later.
wizard.previewEmpty: Nothing to provision for this department/package combination.
wizard.unavailableWarning: {{count}} resource(s) are currently unavailable; you can retry them from the job panel after hiring.

accounts.emptyHint: Accounts appear here once provisioning completes.
accounts.noDrift: No drift detected — actual state matches the desired state.

access.emptyHint: Entitlements come from assigned access packages.

assets.emptyHint: Resources created by the employee are recorded here.

transfer.title: Transfer employee
transfer.description: Change department, position, manager, and access packages; the access diff is computed and applied automatically.

suspend.title: Suspend employee
suspend.description: Stops the runtime, suspends external accounts, and revokes sessions. Workspace, assets, and history are preserved; you can resume anytime.

resume.title: Resume employee
resume.description: Restores the employee's runtime and external account access.

offboard.title: Offboard employee
offboard.description: Stops work, revokes credentials, deprovisions accounts, and transfers owned assets. The employee and all history are kept forever.
offboard.warning: Offboarding is irreversible: external accounts are deprovisioned and the workspace is archived.

packages.settingsDescription: Entitlement bundles assignable at hire time (read-only).
